original_ai_output.title_zh: 加蓬宣布解除为期八个月的社交媒体禁令并恢复访问
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加蓬高等通信委员会（HAC）通过电视声明宣布，解除八个月前实施的社交媒体禁令，恢复对相关平台的访问。该禁令于2月17日实施，当局称网络内容助长冲突、加深分歧，反对派则批评这是滥用权力。禁令实施时，总统恩圭马正面临社会动荡，教师和公务员因低薪与恶劣工作条件举行罢工。BBC表示已联系该国媒体监管机构寻求置评。

key_facts.fact: 加蓬宣布解除实施八个月的社交媒体禁令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gabon says it has lifted a ban on social media imposed eight months ago

key_facts.fact: 高等通信委员会（HAC）于周六通过电视声明宣布这一转变
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The High Communication Authority (HAC) announced the U-turn on Saturday in a televised statement

key_facts.fact: 禁令于2月17日实施，当局称网络内容助长冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The ban had been introduced on 17 February, with the HAC saying that online content was fuelling conflict and deepening divisions in the country

key_facts.fact: 反对派称该禁令是滥用权力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The opposition said the suspension was an abuse of power

key_facts.fact: 禁令实施时总统恩圭马正面临社会动荡，教师和公务员举行罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The ban had been imposed at a time when the Gabonese President Brice Oligui Nguema was facing a wave of social unrest less than a year after his election

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（BBC）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
加蓬媒体监管机构尚未对BBC的置评请求作出回应
